name: zerion-x-ai
description: ZERION-X developmental cognitive runtime (Python) — install/preview/build scripts for the Freebuff UI

scripts.install: cd ai-arena-019ff051-ai && python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt || echo "WARN: optional provider deps unavailable; the core runtime is pure stdlib and will still run"
scripts.build: cd ai-arena-019ff051-ai && python3 -m compileall -q zerion && echo "Python package compiles cleanly; no build artifact needed for preview"
scripts.test: cd ai-arena-019ff051-ai && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
